title: Answer stream
description: A streaming response follows incoming text while preserving the reader’s position when they scroll away.
useCase: Keep incoming responses visible without stealing reading position.
interaction: Replay or stop the response; scroll up, then jump to the latest text.
reducedMotion: Jump to latest is immediate; streamed text arrives without decorative motion.
limitations: A scripted local response. No model, network request or markdown parser.
look: Cool blue-grey page with a white rounded chat pane: arrow-mark header, large navy serif heading and body paragraphs, and a small status footer.
motion: Replay streams three characters every 35 ms while the pane pins to the bottom; scrolling up stops following and shows a pill that smooth-scrolls back to the latest text.
adapt: Streaming is a `setInterval` adding 3 to `count` every 35 ms; a `useLayoutEffect` pins `scrollTop` while `follow` is true, and `onScroll` clears it beyond 28 px from the bottom. Replace `BLOCKS` and the timer with your token stream.
